scope: Serialized full-group owner commit and durable storage acknowledgement/readback; runtime Apply and group IPC/CLI/GUI still pending

contract.receipt: DeviceSettings.group_imports holds last64 records. OperationID32hex, kind, SHA256 original validated archive header (which contains all payload hashes), original target GroupRevision, committed profile/collection revisions and accepted desired-content digest. Same transaction as settings+library. Source export excludes receipts.
contract.identity: PreparedGroup retains source header identity before generated key remap; owner receives Arc<PreparedGroup> so caller/job can retry without decoding/publishing assets again. Reusing ID with different source/group/target is rejected.
contract.owner: New commit includes accepted neighboring queued deltas. Repeated commit preserves newer latest/dirty flags/pins, acknowledges current readback only. Screen commit clears prior screen owner leases; FanAndLighting keeps screen leases. Worker retains preparation even if response receiver disappears.
contract.readback: ReadGroupImport needs ID only, no PreparedGroup or asset publication. Returns original receipt with current latest/library and selected_content_current. Deleted slots or later settings are not replayed. Flag concerns desired settings/slot identities only, not payload rehash, live Apply or visible playback.
contract.recovery: Receipt and settings/profiles recover together through shared journal. Positive acknowledgement checks durable receipt and re-syncs files/directories. Unresolved journal/worker failure stops owner without flushing an older snapshot. Plain stale rejection retains dirty intent. Invalid/missing profile revision evidence is preserved, not replaced.
contract.retention: 64-record bound; evicted original intent still fails stale original target profile revision CAS.

coverage: Dropped commit reply followed by ID readback, repeated Arc preparation does not add assets/revisions, later queued LCD edit retained/dirty and fresh-store restart reads current state.
After slot deletion, old receipt readback returns current library and never resurrects slot.
New import commits queued neighbor settings; stale rejection keeps pending newer state for shutdown flush.
Same ID changed source/target/group rejects;65 commits retain64 receipts and evicted old intent cannot reimport.
Fan group import keeps pending screen media intent and active owner pin.
Unresolved journal stops writer/channel without flushing old state, preserving journal and settings evidence.
Future/missing profile revision receipt blocks reads/replacement and preserves corrupted source bytes.
